texts.desc: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.
texts.name: Reindsurm Carnation
